title: Audio Programs
description: Web-based audio software developed to explore digital signal processing, music production workflows, and interactive sound design. Many of these projects were inspired by professional DAW features.

Audio Blocks.info: My attempt at creating a fun music-making tool by attaching nodes together inside a ReactFlow Graph.

web-daw.info: A complexe interface for producing music in a web browser. it uses Tone.js for processing audio and features recording, effects, routing, automations, editting, instruments, all made from scratch without external libraries.
